concerns.text: Task T009a requires writing a specific K_IC formula in research.md but does not provide the formula or the parameter values (alpha, beta, noise distribution) to be used. The implementer cannot execute this task deterministically without inventing the physics model, which violates the 'Single Source of Truth' principle. The task must either provide the explicit formula or reference a specific section in a design doc where it is defined.

The task must explicitly define the generation logic or reference a completed design artifact containing the exact mathematical model.
